subject: Geopolitics
title: How OPEC Works
description: Learn How OPEC Works in one minute.

hook.text: Thirteen nations control 40% of the world's oil output. Together they set production quotas. Prices obey.

buildup.text: OPEC members agree to limit production. Less oil on the market means higher prices. It is a legal cartel.

discovery.text: Saudi Arabia leads OPEC as the swing producer. It can increase or cut output fastest, setting the market direction.

twist.text: Members cheat constantly. Each nation has an incentive to secretly pump more while others cut. Trust is scarce.

climax.text: OPEC's power comes from coordination. When it fractures, prices crash. Unity is fragile but immensely profitable.

punchline.text: Agree to pump less. Watch the price rise. Hope nobody cheats.

quiz.question: What is the main challenge within OPEC?
options: Members cannot agree on who should join
Individual members have incentives to cheat on quotas
OPEC does not control enough oil to affect prices
